title: Whole Earth Catalog page 187: 15th-century Scandinavian 'Witch Rider' tale
place_text: Soap Plant bookstore, Melrose, Los Angeles; Scandinavia

tellings.quote: And I find this book of outof print uh ghost stories from Scandinavia in the 15th century.

plain: A man named Brent Friedman, a guest on Michels's episode about Hollywood, the CIA and UFOs, says he once came across an out-of-print book of 15th-century Scandinavian ghost stories at the Soap Plant bookstore on Melrose in Los Angeles. He tells Michels he was led to it by page 187 of the Whole Earth Catalog, a counterculture catalog of books and tools, and that the book held a tale called "Witch Rider". He tells the find as his own experience and treats it as an old story that bears on his larger account.
